title: Ready for the Trip?
subtitle: 考点：be ready to / nothing but / 旅行准备
passage: Tom's family is going to Scotland for a ten-day vacation. They plan to visit old castles and stay in the countryside. Tom is ready to go, but he is a very forgetful boy.

The night before the trip, his mother asked him to check his bag. Tom found his camera and a warm coat, but nothing else was in the bag. His passport was missing! He looked for it in his room, under his bed and even in the kitchen.

At last, Tom's sister found it in a book on his desk. “You always forget things,” she laughed. Tom said, “This time I will write a list.” Now he puts his passport, tickets and money in one small bag, so he can find them easily.
vocab: vacation 假期 · countryside 乡村 · forgetful 健忘的 · passport 护照 · look for 寻找 · easily 容易地 · ready 准备好的
